6.70 rsInvalidDataSetReferenceField
rsInvalidDataSetReferenceField is a critical error that will occur when a ReportParameter contains a
DataSetReference that references an existing DataSet, but the peer element
DataSetReference.ValueField references a non-existing Field within that DataSet.
